source: For a Transformer block, attention and the MLP both write updates back into the same width-ZXMATH0000XZ representation. That requirement explains an architectural invariant that can otherwise look arbitrary: even when attention temporarily splits into heads or an MLP expands to a much wider hidden dimension, the branch must project back toZXMATH0001XZ before the residual addition.
zh: 对于 Transformer 块，注意力和 MLP 都将更新写回到相同宽度的 ZXMATH0000XZ 表示中。这一要求解释了一个看起来任意的架构不变量：即使注意力暂时分裂成头或 MLP 扩展到更宽的隐藏维度，分支也必须在残差加法之前投影回 ZXMATH0001XZ。
